credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Recipe: word scaleX 1 → 1.4 in 200 ms (baseline fixed, strokes thin), then springs back to 1 (k 200, c 10, ~0.8 s). Demo 'STRETCH' 40 px, 2.4 s loop: v = sin(π·(t − 0.3)/1.4) × (1 + 0.3·sin 9t·e^−t) for 0.3–1.7 s; letter positions spread from the centre ×(1 + 0.5v), glyph scaleX 1 − 0.35v, scaleY 1 + 0.25v, pivot on the baseline. Params: scaleX: độ giãn đỉnh (1.4) · rise: thời gian giãn (0.2 s) · spring: độ cứng / giảm chấn (200 / 10).
